Full body must be one continuous drawing, all head studies separated with gutters.

Original cartoon caricature based directly on the photograph. Face must NOT become a handsome angular anime/video-game stock hero. No huge slanted angry eyebrows, no chiseled triangular jaw, no high sculpted pompadour. No photographic texture, no 3D, no tiny fussy details. Do not copy photo clothing colors; use the specified game costume.
